title: Thit Nuong Smoked Pork Skewers
summary: Inspired by Southeast Asian street food traditions, these skewers rely on a smoked pork marinade to achieve incredible depth of flavor. Boneless pork shoulder is cold-smoked briefly over aromatic wood chips before being sliced into thin ribbons. The meat marinates in a fragrant mixture of lemongrass, fish sauce, shallots, garlic, palm sugar, and five-spice powder. Threaded onto bamboo skewers, the pork is grilled rapidly over high heat until caramelized with crispy charred edges. Served alongside cold rice vermicelli, quick-pickled daikon and carrots, fresh herbs, and a savory dipping sauce, this dish offers a striking balance of smoky, sweet, salty, and herbal notes. The recipe is packed with high-quality protein, essential minerals, and vitamins while offering an unforgettable dining experience. Perfect for outdoor grilling, these skewers bring authentic street-style charcoal aromas right to your table. Pair with fresh lettuce leaves and crushed peanuts for added texture and classic flavor balance.

steps.step: Soak wooden skewers in cold water for thirty minutes to prevent burning on high grill.
Chill pork shoulder in freezer for twenty minutes to make slicing thin pieces easier.
Trim excess outer fat from semi frozen pork shoulder using a sharp slicing knife.
Slice pork shoulder into thin ribbons approximately one eighth inch thick and wide.
Briefly cold smoke pork strips using hardwood chips in smoker box for fifteen minutes.
Trim tough outer leaves from lemongrass stalks and finely mince tender white inner cores.
Peel shallots and garlic cloves then mince both finely on a clean wooden cutting board.
Combine minced lemongrass minced garlic and minced shallots in a glass mixing bowl.
Add fish sauce dark soy sauce palm sugar and honey to bowl containing minced aromatics.
Stir five spice powder sesame oil and fresh lime juice into liquid marinade mixture.
Whisk marinade thoroughly until palm sugar crystals are completely dissolved into liquid.
Add smoked pork ribbons to bowl and massage marinade into meat using gloved hands.
Cover bowl with plastic wrap and marinate in refrigerator for at least thirty minutes.
Julienne daikon radish and carrots into thin matchstick strips for fresh pickle topping.
Combine rice vinegar granulated sugar and salt in a small bowl until sugar dissolves.
Submerge matchstick carrots and daikon in vinegar solution to pickle for twenty minutes.
Boil water in a pot and cook rice vermicelli noodles for three minutes until tender.
Drain cooked vermicelli noodles in colander and rinse under cold water to stop cooking.
Divide drained cool rice vermicelli into individual serving bowls for quick assembly.
Wash butter lettuce leaves carefully and pat completely dry using clean paper towels.
Wash fresh cilantro and mint leaves then pick leaves off tough stem sections.
Whisk chili garlic sauce warm water fish sauce and lime juice to make dipping sauce.
Remove soaked bamboo skewers from water bath and wipe dry with a clean cloth.
Remove marinated smoked pork strips from refrigerator and uncover glass mixing bowl.
Thread smoked pork strips tightly onto bamboo skewers accordion style until covered.
Leave bottom three inches of each bamboo skewer exposed for easy handling on grill.
Place assembled pork skewers on a clean tray and brush with remaining bowl marinade.
Preheat gas or charcoal grill to high heat until cooking grates are extremely hot.
Oil hot grill grates thoroughly using tongs holding folded paper towel dipped in oil.
Lay pork skewers onto hot grates in a single layer leaving space between skewers.
Grill pork skewers for three minutes without moving until rich grill marks form below.
Flip skewers over using metal tongs and grill second side for three additional minutes.
Baste skewers with any remaining marinade while turning to create a sweet shiny glaze.
Ensure edges of pork are charred crisply while meat remains juicy and cooked through.
Transfer hot grilled skewers onto a clean platter and let rest for two minutes.
Arrange fresh butter lettuce leaves around rim of noodle bowls for wrap assembly.
Drain pickled daikon and carrots from liquid and place alongside vermicelli noodles.
Top vermicelli noodles with generous heaps of fresh cilantro and mint leaves.
Place two hot grilled pork skewers onto each prepared noodle bowl directly over herbs.
Sprinkle crushed toasted peanuts over hot pork skewers and noodles for extra crunch.
Spoon prepared sweet chili dipping sauce over skewers right before serving guests.
Serve immediately with extra lime wedges and fresh chili slices on side platter.
